$comment: Intake contract for client-issues: list every source file path worth mining, plus a short scope note. Files become the parallel fan-out collection.
title: InventoryResult

files.$comment: Absolute or workspace-relative paths the analyst can open with tools. Empty list is allowed but the workflow short-circuits via if_empty.

items.$comment: One path per entry; prefer stable paths the next stage can read.

notes.$comment: Brief intake narrative (coverage, skipped noise, caveats). Not used as a hard gate.
